packageRules.description: Base image bumps for released images land as 'build' so release-please cuts a patch release for the affected image. Digests are pinned (index/manifest-list digest, so multi-arch builds still resolve per-platform) - upstream rebuilds a floating tag like debian:13 without changing the tag string, and only a digest bump catches that.
Templates aren't built/released by this pipeline (no release-please package exists for docker/templates/**) - keep them updated without implying a release is needed.
Deprecated legacy images are not released anymore, skip churn.
